[B2] < UserX | 'near' : deviceA , ... > $ UserX 'leave' deviceA
=> < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > .
[B3] < deviceA | 'key' : Key , ... > $ UserX 'pressButton' deviceA

=> < UserX | 'key' : Key , ... > .

=> < cloudA | deviceA : ('owner' : UserX , 'key' : Key , ...) > .
